items.q: But that's where Leonard Feather got the idea

ctx.x: Well, it's been said that some of those early riffs were drum-type riffs, and Kenny Clarke was involved with "Salt Peanuts" and things like that.
Yeah. Well, Klook used to make it, like BRRP-BOP, BRRP-BOP, in there... You could say "Be-Bop, Be-Bop, Be-Bop." But that's where Leonard Feather got the idea
